nodes.question: Why are metal-free organic sensitizers preferred over Ru (II)-based sensitizers?
nodes.answer: Metal-free organic sensitizers are preferred because they have a versatile structure, economical manufacture, and enhanced molar extinction coefficients that facilitate intramolecular charge transfer (ICT).
